title: replace-policy leg cannot distinguish old-policy vs new-policy validation ordering
description: python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py:954: the replace-policy iteration uses a replacement policy identical to the old one, so validation placed after self.__policy = self._copy_policy(...) (stratum.py:473) produces the identical observable reason 'below-live-epoch-floor:accepted'. Only a replacement policy that would itself reject the below-floor sample can distinguish the orderings. The bead's core requirement (clear happens inside replace_policy before any read) is still pinned; this is the remaining ordering nuance.
